title: German Roasted Onion Hash
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring roasted onions and crispy hash browns. Perfect as a side dish or main course.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.notes: Russet or Idaho work well for hash browns

instructions: Peel and slice onions into thick rings. Separate into individual rings.
Toss onions with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast onions in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until caramelized and tender.
Grate potatoes using a box grater or food processor.
Squeeze out excess moisture from grated potatoes using a paper towel.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add grated potatoes and cook until crispy, stirring occasionally.
Flatten cooked hash browns slightly using a spatula. Set aside.
To assemble, place a portion of roasted onions on a plate or in a bowl, followed by a portion of crispy hash browns.
